rules.name: xoga713-core-deploy-verify
rules.sql: SELECT orderexecuted, id, author, filename, exectype, dateexecuted FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE filename LIKE '%create-helper-var-mult-factor-view.xml' OR filename LIKE '%add-views-for-var-report.xml' OR filename LIKE '%add-tables-for-var-report.xml' OR filename LIKE '%add-tables-for-rmo-trade-query-report-tables.xml' OR filename LIKE '%alter-fn-populate-security-info-strikes-search-path.xml' ORDER BY orderexecuted
SELECT id, author, exectype, dateexecuted FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id = 'create-helper_var_mult_factor_view-view-v2' AND author = 'oga-opera'
SELECT id, author, exectype, dateexecuted FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id = 'create-helper_var_accounting_report-view-v1' AND author = 'Nihal'
SELECT locked::int AS locked, lockedby FROM opera.databasechangeloglock

SELECT count(*) AS found, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (relname IN ('helper_var_mult_factor_view', 'helper_var_accounting_report') AND relkind = 'v') OR (relname IN ('curr_mult_table', 'var_dynamic_report', 'derivative_type_table', 'rms_premium_paid_table') AND relkind IN ('r', 'p'))) AS right_kind FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relname IN ('helper_var_mult_factor_view', 'helper_var_accounting_report', 'curr_mult_table', 'var_dynamic_report', 'derivative_type_table', 'rms_premium_paid_table')

SELECT (pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) LIKE '%underlying_settle_value_table%')::int AS live_formula, (pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) LIKE '%asset_class%')::int AS equity_filter, (pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) LIKE '%curr_mult_table%')::int AS old_stored_table FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relname = 'helper_var_mult_factor_view' AND c.relkind = 'v'

SELECT (SELECT value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1) AS cfs_value_date, count(*) AS view_rows, count(m.curr_mult) AS with_curr_mult FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view m WHERE m.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1) AND m.value_date = (SELECT value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1)
SELECT count(*) AS rows_found FROM (SELECT 1 FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report LIMIT 1) t

expect.reason: the four changelog files ran: 2 + 5 + 3 + 6 changesets, plus the strikes search-path fix
changeSet v2 (live multiplier view) is recorded
v2 really ran, it was not skipped by a precondition
the accounting view changeSet is recorded (a failed precondition with CONTINUE leaves no row)
Liquibase finished and released its lock
two are views and four are tables
equity and equity swaps are excluded, as in legacy
the view no longer reads the stored curr_mult_table
the view returns about 120 products for the CFS valuation date
curr_mult is filled where the FX price exists
the accounting view can be read without an error (needs its source views)
